description: The five scripts added by pdfnative 1.8 (add_international_text v1.7.0): Lao (`lo`, dedicated shaper), Tai Tham / Lanna (`nod`) and Cham (`cjm`) through the Universal Shaping Engine, New Tai Lue (`khb`) and Tai Le (`tdd`) — 27 scripts in all. `lang` is an array so each run is routed to the font that covers it, with `latin` for the labels. Fonts are always embedded by this tool. The claim is `pdfa2b` on purpose: Lao, New Tai Lue, Tai Le and Cham also pass level U (`pdfa2u`), but one shaped Tai Tham glyph has no Unicode mapping in pdfnative 1.8.0, so veraPDF rejects Tai Tham at level U (ISO 19005-2 6.2.11.7.2) — use `pdfa2b` whenever `nod` is in the list. Tagged output carries /ActualText, which is what lets extract_text return these scripts in logical order. Self-contained: runs end-to-end with no placeholders.
